value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks partly sunny with a high around 65, anywhere from 64 to 67 depending on the source. Wind out of the north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph, with gusts up to 17 in the afternoon. Rain could move in Tuesday evening, about a 30% chance after 3 p.m., and nights drop into the 30s and low 40s with showers around.
